result.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: the migration creates embeddable_hosts with only `t.string :host, null: false` (no unique index) and EmbeddableHost has only a format validation (no uniqueness). record_for_host does `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` with no ORDER BY, so duplicate hosts yield nondeterministic category assignment for imported topics (topic_embed uses `eh.try(:category_id)`). This is a concrete data-integrity/correctness gap introduced by the new model.
